description: This file defines the LocalPlugin class within the WPEFramework::Plugin::Rust namespace. The class implements the Rust::IPlugin interface and provides methods for plugin lifecycle management, invocation, and interaction with Rust code through function pointers. It also manages plugin references, external dependencies, and communication channels, serving as an adapter between C++ and Rust components in a plugin architecture.
